identity.name: DWH Catalog Sensitivity and Classification Metadata

purpose: Define catalog projection of data classification, sensitivity and handling metadata while preserving the owning classification policy as authority and preventing catalog labels from independently declassifying or reclassifying data.

owns: DWH Catalog Sensitivity and Classification Metadata semantics

members.name: DWH Catalog Sensitivity and Classification Metadata

semantics.purpose: Define catalog projection of data classification, sensitivity and handling metadata while preserving the owning classification policy as authority and preventing catalog labels from independently declassifying or reclassifying data.

semantics.source_rule: Catalog classification metadata references exact owning classification/policy evidence.
semantics.projection_rule: Catalog may project sensitivity/classification labels for discovery/governance UX.
semantics.authority_rule: Catalog metadata is not the classification authority; owning schema/policy remains authoritative.
semantics.declassification_rule: Editing catalog metadata cannot lower classification without the explicit declassification boundary.
semantics.inheritance_rule: Dataset/field classification summaries are derived from exact underlying classifications and explicit join/summary rules.
semantics.redaction_rule: Sensitive metadata itself may be hidden/redacted according to policy.
semantics.conflict_rule: Catalog-versus-source classification mismatch is an explicit validation finding and never silently reconciled in favor of catalog.
semantics.lineage_rule: Derived dataset classification can retain source/lineage refs.

invariants.rule: Catalog and metadata records describe exact DWH resources and evidence; discovery, labels, annotations, ranking or catalog visibility never replace canonical resource identity, semantic ownership, classification policy or authorization.

references.purpose: Catalog classification summaries derive from explicit propagation.

prose.summary: Define catalog projection of data classification, sensitivity and handling metadata while preserving the owning classification policy as authority and preventing catalog labels from independently declassifying or reclassifying data.
notes: Unlocked pending reconciliation against DWH schema, lineage, classification and discovery contracts.
